title: Dispatch: 19.4.6 repair after review 19.4.6.3 S1-S4 (attempt 3)
description: Repair PR #656 per review eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6.3 (Opus fallback for Sol; read all four notes appends in full, including sibling analysis and closure). Same rule (bd memory magic-item-faithful-or-absent): exact verbatim predicate or absent with a verbatim adjudicated span; never invent defaults. (S1) operations still omitting printed conditions ACROSS THE CORPUS: every staff cast operation (Charming, Fire, Frost, Healing, Power, Swarming Insects, the Magi, and any other 'While holding it' staff) gets the printed holding requirement as the wands/rods already do; Ring of Elemental Command post-slay casts carry their variant (linked plane) as well as the help-slay prerequisite; Folding Boat fold-boat 'no creatures aboard'; Sphere of Annihilation attempt-control 'within 60 feet'; use_item-executable Rope of Entanglement escape-rope and Ioun Stone grab-orbiting-stone state their printed actor (restrained target / another creature) WITHOUT changing their readiness; Chime of Opening, Dimensional Shackles (incapacitated creature), Iron Flask entry ('a creature that you can see') targets. Then sweep: every operation whose item text prints a holding/wearing/on-your-person/within-N-feet/target predicate for that use must carry it verbatim; extend the whole-corpus screen so this class is checked, not just listed items. (S2) state graphs: Apparatus of the Crab lever 10 up/down direction must be typed in the transition, not a note; Eversmoking Bottle growth only while open and within the cloud (not a plain timer) or absent; Sphere / Iron Bands / Rope of Entanglement transitions must not fire on a failed check / miss / successful save (outcome-conditioned transitions or absent); Immovable Rod termination must not treat the DC 30 move as releasing the rod; Marvelous Pigments value condition and termination per the printed text; Folding Boat boat<->ship transitions only if printed (else remove). (S3) spellStore: Ring of Spell Storing and Ioun Stone (Reserve) store/cast cost uses the existing schema value 'spell-normal-casting-time' (as Rod of Absorption), not 'free'. (S4) Necklace of Prayer Beads: once per dawn PER BEAD (1d4+2 beads), not one shared per-day use; keep the economy faithful or absent. RUNTIME SAFETY: re-run the readiness comparison (all item/variant/operation combinations) before/after; the passing set must stay identical (19) unless a source-required change is reported; check toolUseItem, toolSpendUsage, toolResetUsage, itemState, itemResetExecutor, usageCounters, magicItemVariants before changing fields. Evidence: generalized checks for each class (operation predicate presence across the corpus; outcome-conditioned transitions; spellStore costs; per-instance economies) with representative eligible/ineligible scenarios, not per-item reproducers; regenerate pack + inventory; verify:dnd5e-srd-pack. Importer protocol. Host memory: wait until pgrep -fc '^node .*verify-current-worktree' prints 0 or 1; npm run verify:worktree && git commit. Notes: member table + readiness comparison; close this bead. No push/PR.
